StepState.title: StepState
StepState.description: Execution-tracking record of one step: status, attempts, and the last action-lifecycle fact recorded against it.

StepId.title: StepId
StepId.description: Plan-local step identity: a bare lowercase slug, unique within its plan.

StepStatus.title: StepStatus
StepStatus.description: Step execution-tracking state: pending, dispatched, authorized, executed, failed, rejected, or skipped (last four terminal).

ActionEventPhase.title: ActionEventPhase
ActionEventPhase.description: Action lifecycle phase recorded by an event (W010 vocabulary): proposed, authorized, rejected, executed, effects-recorded, or failed.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).
